steps:
Let $\mathrm{y}=\left(\frac{\sqrt{3 \mathrm{e}}}{2 \sin \mathrm{x}}\right)^{\sin ^{2} \mathrm{x}}$
$$\begin{array}{l}
\ln y=\sin ^{2} x \cdot \ln \left(\frac{\sqrt{3 e}}{2 \sin x}\right) \\
\frac{1}{y} y^{\prime}=\ln \left(\frac{\sqrt{3 e}}{2 \sin x}\right) 2 \sin x \cos x+\sin ^{2} x \frac{2 \sin x}{\sqrt{3 e}} \frac{\sqrt{3 e}}{2}(-\operatorname{cosec} x \cot x) \\
\frac{d y}{d x}=0 \Rightarrow \ln \left(\frac{\sqrt{3 e}}{2 \sin x}\right) 2 \sin x \cos x-\sin x \cos x=0 \\
\Rightarrow \sin x \cos x\left[2 \ln \left(\frac{\sqrt{3 e}}{2 \sin x}\right)-1\right]=0 \\
\Rightarrow \ln \left(\frac{3 e}{4 \sin ^{2} x}\right)=1 \Rightarrow \frac{3 e}{4 \sin ^{2} x}=e \Rightarrow \sin ^{2} x=\frac{3}{4} \\
\Rightarrow \sin x=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \quad\left(\text { as } x \in\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\right) \\
\Rightarrow \operatorname{local} \max \text { value }=\left(\frac{\sqrt{3 e}}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^{3 / 4}=e^{3 / 8}=\frac{k}{e} \\
\Rightarrow k^{8}=e^{11} \\
\Rightarrow\left(\frac{k}{e}\right)^{8}+\frac{k^{8}}{e^{5}}+k^{8}=e^{3}+e^{6}+e^{11}
\end{array}$$

questions.text: Two circles in the first quadrant of radii $\mathrm{r}_{1}$ and $\mathrm{r}_{2}$ touch the coordinate axes. Each of them cuts off an intercept of 2 units with the line $\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}=2$. Then $r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}-r_{1} r_{2}$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_$ .

steps:
Circle $(x-a)^{2}+(y-a)^{2}=a^{2}$
$x^{2}+y^{2}-2 a x-2 a y+a^{2}=0$
intercept $=2$
$\Rightarrow 2 \sqrt{\mathrm{a}^{2}-\mathrm{d}^{2}}=2$

Where $\mathrm{d}=$ perpendicular distance of centre from line $\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}=2$
$\Rightarrow 2 \sqrt{\mathrm{a}^{2}-\left(\frac{\mathrm{a}+\mathrm{a}-2}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^{2}}=2$
$\Rightarrow \mathrm{a}^{2}-\frac{(2 \mathrm{a}-2)^{2}}{2}=1 \Rightarrow 2 \mathrm{a}^{2}-4 \mathrm{a}^{2}+8 \mathrm{a}-4=2$
$\Rightarrow 2 \mathrm{a}^{2}-8 \mathrm{a}+6=0 \Rightarrow \mathrm{a}^{2}-4 \mathrm{a}+3=0$
$\therefore \mathrm{r}_{1}+\mathrm{r}_{2}=4$ and $\mathrm{r}_{1} \mathrm{r}_{2}=3$
$\therefore r_{1}^{2}+r_{2}^{2}-r_{1} r_{2}=\left(r_{1}+r_{2}\right)^{2}-3 r_{1} r_{2}$
$=16-9=7$
